title: Meager quantity and much less variety than advertised. Buyer Beware. Disappointed :(
text: I bought the small dog box expecting a good variety and quantity for the value but was very disappointed. The site advertises that the box comes with 15-20 chews, but I only got 12 pieces of just a few varieties. The description says: "What comes in a Gnaw Box? Bully Chews, Beef Jerky, Ear Chews, Yak Chews, Tendon Chews, Salmon Chews,Trachea Chews, Tripe Chews." That is at least 8 different varieties they listed, but I only got 2 pig ears, 3 tripes, and the rest were straight and braided Bully sticks. I was hoping it was more of a spread out variety of samplers so I could see which my puppy liked most (and later purchase more of) but after this experience I feel it wasn't worth the price (and shipping was slow for a subscription box). Save your money and buy elsewhere. =(
label: negative
